summary: Firefly III is a self-hosted personal finance manager designed to track personal accounts, credit cards, and cash flow. It includes a rule engine for categorising transactions automatically and provides budgeting tools to forecast future expenses. You can also import external transaction data from various financial institutions.
goodFor: It suits individuals who want to take full control of their personal financial records on their own infrastructure rather than relying on commercial budgeting services.
watchOut: Self-hosting financial data carries inherent privacy and security responsibilities, and setting up complex import rules or integrating multiple bank feeds requires significant configuration effort.
deployNotes: As a PHP and Docker application, deployment typically requires persistent storage for your database and uploaded files, alongside a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
